name: Banana Company 2
summary:
In this game you are a funny banana but that's not all, you can also be, another banana, or even a tall city building. There are also very stylish cosmetics to show off your' theme to your friends and to the community.

If you want new updates and events constantly almost every week then join the Banana Company Community.

Every Thursday we have major updates and every player count goal brings something fun and new. The game is always changing and only changing because of you!

Created with love by- Zane2ev
